dct_description_sm: A manuscript copy of a manuscript original.

A manuscript copy of a manuscript original. Oriented with north toward the lower right. Pen-and-ink and pencil on tracing linen mounted on cloth. Includes notes. "Certificate April 12-1833 through 34". In pen and ink on octagonal blue bordered label in lower right corner: 851 1834. Transferred from the USCGS January 15, 1914. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. ga10 map
